title: Don't Be That Guy - 3rd Party IBM Software Support
description: 'Don't Be That Guy' is a series of video shorts that take both a comical and metaphorical approach to purchasing IBM software support and maintenance cons that come along after your software purchase.   With this campaign, we aim to break the status quo when it comes to renewing with IBM - “If it ain't broke, why fix it…”; With this quirky take we aim to enable those in the industry to realize there is more IBM software support options out there. You don't have to be tied into IBM's lengthy and costly IBM software support contracts, there are high quality alternatives at more than half the cost.  Know how to switch to Origina and save up to 60% your IBM Software Support costs.

Of course I can, Sam. No problem. Great. Just flat out at the minute. Completely swamped. When do you think you'll be free? Let's say Friday. But it is Friday. I meant next Friday. Week. Now this first time will cost you 500. 500? The good news is that you'll qualify for a. Five-year contract which will cover all your punctures. Okay. At say 250 a pop. Right. Pending my availability of course. Of course. I wouldn't worry about that. Because we'll upgrade you to a newer model long before then. Easily tricked or. You're deceived. What? Seven down, eight letters. Gold? Thanks, Sam. You're not that guy, right? But what if the bike was an IBM application and the punctures were software support? And the 500 ran into millions? No, Sam. When you're ready. Don't be that guy. Get lower cost, better quality and more responsive IBM software support with Origina. Seriously, don't be that guy.

textual.context: Commercial campaign promotion; the description presents the approach as comical and metaphorical. The records do not establish whether the savings claim applies in practice or under what terms.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised financial saving is directly linked to switching support provider, which may require later assessment of the offer's conditions and substantiation.
textual.limitations: These records do not verify Origina's identity, the claimed savings, contract terms, service quality, or any financial outcome.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it uses a comical, metaphorical bike-repair scenario to advertise switching to Origina for IBM software support. It claims lower costs or savings of up to 60%, but presents this as a commercial service claim without requesting investment, credentials, or other deceptive participation.
